verdict.rationale: Datadog's LLM Observability Experiments feature is documented as helping users understand how changes to prompts, models, or providers affect performance. It also lists "Compare results to evaluate impact" alongside versioned datasets, which is a direct first-party capability for comparing runs across versions. The evidence is only short bullet-level claims, though, with no detail on a side-by-side view or regression flagging. missing for 10: explicit side-by-side run comparison UI documentation, regression detection or diffing details, hands-on or independent corroboration

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can compare eval runs side by side to catch regressions between prompt or model versions

citations.quote: It helps you understand how changes to prompts, models, providers, or system architecture affect performance.
